text: Yes, there was tree-cover loss on this property in 2020. The Hansen Global Forest Change dataset detected 0.7 hectares of loss, meeting the 0.5-hectare minimum event area threshold. The JRC Global Forest Cover 2020 dataset corroborated this, confirming the area was forested in 2020. The MGAP forest map indicated the affected area was planted forest (0.4 ha of *Pinus elliottii* and *Pinus taeda*), not native forest. While an additional 1.3 hectares of loss in smaller patches was observed, these were excluded as they fell below the size threshold. The loss represents 0.02% of the total asset area.
